\left[ S ^ {2}, \boldsymbol {S} ^ {(1)} \right] = 2 \mathrm {i} \hbar \left(\boldsymbol {S} ^ {(1)} \times \boldsymbol {S} ^ {(2)}\right).
$$

注释 因为 $S _ { z } ^ { ( 1 ) }$ 与 $S ^ { 2 }$ J.不对易，不能找到它们共同的本征矢.为了得到 $S ^ { 2 }$ J.的本征态，需要对 $S _ { z } ^ { ( 1 ) }$ 的本征态进行线性组合.这就是 CG 系数(方程 (4.183)) 能为我们

做的.另一方面，根据方程 (4.185) 明显的推论， $S ^ { ( 1 ) } + S ^ { ( 2 ) }$ 与 $S ^ { 2 }$ 对易，这仅仅证实了我们熟知的结果(见方程 (4.103)).
raw_problem.solution_text:
对易关系

$$
\begin{array}{l} \left[ S ^ {2}, S _ {z} ^ {(1)} \right] = \left[ \left(\boldsymbol {S} ^ {(1)}\right) ^ {2} + \left(\boldsymbol {S} ^ {(2)}\right) ^ {2} + 2 \boldsymbol {S} ^ {(1)} \cdot \boldsymbol {S} ^ {(2)}, S _ {z} ^ {(1)} \right] \\ = \left[ \left(\boldsymbol {S} ^ {(1)}\right) ^ {2}, S _ {z} ^ {(1)} \right] + \left[ \left(\boldsymbol {S} ^ {(2)}\right) ^ {2}, S _ {z} ^ {(1)} \right] + 2 \left[ \boldsymbol {S} ^ {(1)} \cdot \boldsymbol {S} ^ {(2)}, S _ {z} ^ {(1)} \right]. \\ \end{array}
$$

由方程 (4.102) $\left[ L ^ { 2 } , L _ { x } \right] = \left[ L ^ { 2 } , L _ { y } \right] = \left[ L ^ { 2 } , L _ { z } \right] = 0$ 知上式可化为

$$
\begin{array}{l} 0 + 0 + 2 \left\{S _ {x} ^ {(2)} \left[ S _ {x} ^ {(1)}, S _ {z} ^ {(1)} \right] + S _ {y} ^ {(2)} \left[ S _ {y} ^ {(1)}, S _ {z} ^ {(1)} \right] + S _ {z} ^ {(2)} \left[ S _ {z} ^ {(1)}, S _ {z} ^ {(1)} \right] \right\} \\ = 2 \left(- \mathrm {i} \hbar S _ {y} ^ {(1)} S _ {x} ^ {(2)} + \mathrm {i} \hbar S _ {x} ^ {(1)} S _ {y} ^ {(2)} + 0\right) = 2 \mathrm {i} \hbar \left(\boldsymbol {S} ^ {(1)} \times \boldsymbol {S} ^ {(2)}\right) _ {z}. \\ \end{array}
$$

同理可得

$$
\left[ S ^ {2}, S _ {x} ^ {(1)} \right] = 2 \mathrm {i} \hbar \left(\boldsymbol {S} ^ {(1)} \times \boldsymbol {S} ^ {(2)}\right) _ {x},
$$

$$
\left[ S ^ {2}, S _ {y} ^ {(1)} \right] = 2 \mathrm {i} \hbar \left(\pmb {S} ^ {(1)} \times \pmb {S} ^ {(2)}\right) _ {y}.
$$

所以

$$
\left[ S ^ {2}, \boldsymbol {S} ^ {(1)} \right] = 2 \mathrm {i} \hbar \left(\boldsymbol {S} ^ {(1)} \times \boldsymbol {S} ^ {(2)}\right).
$$

# 串串*习题 4.42

(a) 利用方程(4.190) 和广义埃伦菲斯特定理(方程 (3.73))，证明:

$$
\frac {\mathrm {d} \langle \boldsymbol {r} \rangle}{\mathrm {d} t} = \frac {1}{m} \left\langle (\boldsymbol {p} - q \boldsymbol {A}) \right\rangle .
$$

提示 这代表三个方程一一每一个方程对应一个分量.求出 $x$ 分量，并推广你的结论.

(b) 通常采用 $\langle v \rangle$ 定义 $\mathrm { d } \left. \pmb { r } \right. / \mathrm { d } t$ (见方程(1.32)). 证明:①

$$
m \frac {\mathrm {d} \left\langle \pmb {v} \right\rangle}{\mathrm {d} t} = q \left\langle \pmb {E} \right\rangle + \frac {q}{2 m} \left\langle (\pmb {p} \times \pmb {B} - \pmb {B} \times \pmb {p}) \right\rangle - \frac {q ^ {2}}{m} \left\langle (\pmb {A} \times \pmb {B}) \right\rangle .
$$

(c) 特别地，如果电场 $\pmb { { \cal E } }$ 和磁场 $\textbf {  { B } }$ 在整个波包体积中是均匀的，证明:

$$
m \frac {\mathrm {d} \langle \boldsymbol {v} \rangle}{\mathrm {d} t} = q (\boldsymbol {E} + \langle \boldsymbol {v} \rangle \times \boldsymbol {B}),
$$

因此，正如从埃伦菲斯特定理中所期望的那样，速度 $\boldsymbol { v }$ 期望值的变化遵从洛伦兹定律.

证明 (时方程 (3.73)

$$
\frac {\mathrm {d}}{\mathrm {d} t} \left<   \hat {Q} \right> = \frac {\mathrm {i}}{\hbar} \left<   \left[ \hat {H}, \hat {Q} \right]\right> + \left<   \frac {\partial \hat {Q}}{\partial t} \right > ,
$$

我们直接可以得到

$$
\frac {\mathrm {d} \left<   \boldsymbol {r} \right > }{\mathrm {d} t} = \frac {\mathrm {i}}{\hbar} \left<   [ H, \boldsymbol {r} ] \right > ,
$$

由方程 (4.190) 绘出哈密顿量为

$$
\begin{array}{l} \hat {H} = \frac {1}{2 m} \left(- \mathrm {i} \hbar \nabla - q \boldsymbol {A}\right) ^ {2} + q \varphi = \frac {1}{2 m} \left(\boldsymbol {p} - q \boldsymbol {A}\right) \left(\boldsymbol {p} - q \boldsymbol {A}\right) + q \varphi \\ = \frac {1}{2 m} \left[ p ^ {2} - q (\boldsymbol {p} \cdot \boldsymbol {A} + \boldsymbol {A} \cdot \boldsymbol {p}) + q ^ {2} A ^ {2} \right] + q \varphi . \\ \end{array}
$$

先考虑 $_ x$ 方向的情况，

$$
[ H, x ] = \frac {1}{2 m} [ p ^ {2}, x ] - \frac {q}{2 m} [ (\boldsymbol {p} \cdot \boldsymbol {A} + \boldsymbol {A} \cdot \boldsymbol {p}), x ].
$$

$H$ 中的常数项和坐标对易. )其中，

$$
\left[ p ^ {2}, x \right] = \left[ \left(p _ {x} ^ {2} + p _ {y} ^ {2} + p _ {z} ^ {2}\right), x \right] = \left[ p _ {x} ^ {2}, x \right] = p _ {x} \left[ p _ {x}, x \right] + \left[ p _ {x}, x \right] p _ {x} = - 2 \mathrm {i} \hbar p _ {x},
$$

$$
[ \boldsymbol {p} \cdot \boldsymbol {A}, x ] = [ p _ {x} A _ {x} + p _ {y} A _ {y} + p _ {z} A _ {z}, x ] = [ p _ {x} A _ {x}, x ] = p _ {x} [ A _ {x}, x ] + [ p _ {x}, x ] A _ {x} = - \mathrm {i} \hbar A _ {x},
$$

$$
[ \boldsymbol {A} \cdot \boldsymbol {p}, x ] = [ A _ {x} p _ {x} + A _ {y} p _ {y} + A _ {z} p _ {z}, x ] = [ A _ {x} p _ {x}, x ] = A _ {x} [ p _ {x}, x ] + [ A _ {x}, x ] p _ {x} = - \mathrm {i} \hbar A _ {x},
$$

所以，

$$
[ H, x ] = \frac {1}{2 m} \left(- 2 \mathrm {i} \hbar p _ {x}\right) - \frac {q}{2 m} \left(- 2 \mathrm {i} \hbar A _ {x}\right) = - \frac {\mathrm {i} \hbar}{m} \left(p _ {x} - q A _ {x}\right).
$$

推广到三维，得

$$
\frac {\mathrm {d} \langle \boldsymbol {r} \rangle}{\mathrm {d} t} = \frac {1}{m} \left\langle (\boldsymbol {p} - q \boldsymbol {A}) \right\rangle .
$$

(b) (a) 中结论，得

$$
\langle \boldsymbol {v} \rangle = \frac {\mathrm {d} \langle \boldsymbol {r} \rangle}{\mathrm {d} t} = \frac {1}{m} \left\langle (\boldsymbol {p} - q \boldsymbol {A}) \right\rangle .
$$

因此，可以定义速度算符为

$$
\boldsymbol {v} = \frac {\mathrm {d} \boldsymbol {r}}{\mathrm {d} t} = \frac {1}{m} (\boldsymbol {p} - q \boldsymbol {A}).
$$

利用方程 (3.73) ，得

$$
\frac {\mathrm {d} \langle \boldsymbol {v} \rangle}{\mathrm {d} t} = \frac {\mathrm {i}}{\hbar} \left\langle [ H, \boldsymbol {v} ] \right\rangle + \left\langle \frac {\partial \boldsymbol {v}}{\partial t} \right\rangle , \text {其 中} \left\langle \frac {\partial \boldsymbol {v}}{\partial t} \right\rangle = \frac {1}{m} \left\langle \frac {\partial}{\partial t} (\boldsymbol {p} - q \boldsymbol {A}) \right\rangle = - \frac {q}{m} \left\langle \frac {\partial \boldsymbol {A}}{\partial t} \right\rangle .
$$

此时，我们要求出 $H$ 和 $\boldsymbol { v }$ 的对易关系，因此哈密顿量要用" $\boldsymbol { v }$ 表示:

$$
H = \frac {1}{2} m v ^ {2} + q \varphi ,
$$

则

$$
[ H, \boldsymbol {v} ] = \frac {1}{2} m [ v ^ {2}, \boldsymbol {v} ] + q [ \varphi , \boldsymbol {v} ] = \frac {1}{2} m [ v ^ {2}, \boldsymbol {v} ] + \frac {q}{m} [ \varphi , \boldsymbol {p} ],
$$

其中，

$$
[ \varphi , \boldsymbol {p} ] = \mathrm {i} \hbar \left(\frac {\partial \varphi}{\partial x}\right) _ {x} + \mathrm {i} \hbar \left(\frac {\partial \varphi}{\partial y}\right) _ {y} + \mathrm {i} \hbar \left(\frac {\partial \varphi}{\partial z}\right) _ {z} = \mathrm {i} \hbar \nabla \varphi .
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} \left[ v ^ {2}, v _ {x} \right] = \left[ \left(v _ {x} ^ {2} + v _ {y} ^ {2} + v _ {z} ^ {2}\right), v _ {x} \right] = \left[ \left(v _ {y} ^ {2} + v _ {z} ^ {2}\right), v _ {x} \right] = \left[ v _ {y} ^ {2}, v _ {x} \right] + \left[ v _ {z} ^ {2}, v _ {x} \right] \\ = v _ {y} \left[ v _ {y}, v _ {x} \right] + \left[ v _ {y}, v _ {x} \right] v _ {y} + v _ {z} \left[ v _ {z}, v _ {x} \right] + \left[ v _ {z}, v _ {x} \right] v _ {z}. \\ \end{array}
$$

速度的对易关系要转换成动量和磁矢势的对易关系

$$
\begin{array}{l} [ v _ {y}, v _ {x} ] = \left[ \frac {1}{m} (p _ {y} - q A _ {y}), \frac {1}{m} (p _ {x} - q A _ {x}) \right] = \frac {1}{m ^ {2}} [ (p _ {y} - q A _ {y}), (p _ {x} - q A _ {x}) ] \\ = \frac {1}{m ^ {2}} \left([ p _ {y}, p _ {x} ] - q [ p _ {y}, A _ {x} ] - q [ A _ {y}, p _ {x} ] + q ^ {2} [ A _ {y}, A _ {x} ]\right) \\ = - \frac {q}{m ^ {2}} \left(\left[ p _ {y}, A _ {x} \right] + \left[ A _ {y}, p _ {x} \right]\right) \\ = - \frac {q}{m ^ {2}} \left(\left[ - \mathrm {i} \hbar \frac {\partial}{\partial y}, A _ {x} \right] + \left[ A _ {y}, - \mathrm {i} \hbar \frac {\partial}{\partial x} \right]\right). \\ \end{array}
$$

对于对易算符的最终形式，需要将其作用到任意披函数上，最后再将其移除，

$$
\begin{array}{l} \left[ v _ {y}, v _ {x} \right] \psi = - \frac {q}{m ^ {2}} \left(\left[ - \mathrm {i} \hbar \frac {\partial}{\partial y}, A _ {x} \right] + \left[ A _ {y}, - \mathrm {i} \hbar \frac {\partial}{\partial x} \right]\right) \psi \\ = - \frac {q}{m ^ {2}} \left(\left[ - \mathrm {i} \hbar \frac {\partial}{\partial y}, A _ {x} \right] \psi + \left[ A _ {y}, - \mathrm {i} \hbar \frac {\partial}{\partial x} \right] \psi\right) \\ = - \frac {q}{m ^ {2}} \left[ \left(- \mathrm {i} \hbar \frac {\partial}{\partial y}\right) (A _ {x} \psi) - A _ {x} \left(- \mathrm {i} \hbar \frac {\partial}{\partial y}\right) \psi \right. \\ \left. + A _ {y} \left(- \mathrm {i} \hbar \frac {\partial}{\partial x}\right) \psi - \left(- \mathrm {i} \hbar \frac {\partial}{\partial x}\right) (A _ {y} \psi) \right] \\ = - \frac {q}{m ^ {2}} \left[ \left(- \mathrm {i} \hbar \frac {\partial A _ {x}}{\partial y}\right) \psi + \left(- \mathrm {i} \hbar \frac {\partial \psi}{\partial y}\right) A _ {x} - A _ {x} \left(- \mathrm {i} \hbar \frac {\partial \psi}{\partial y}\right) + A _ {y} \left(- \mathrm {i} \hbar \frac {\partial \psi}{\partial x}\right) \right. \\ \left. - \left(- \mathrm {i} \hbar \frac {\partial A _ {y}}{\partial x}\right) \psi - \left(- \mathrm {i} \hbar \frac {\partial \psi}{\partial x}\right) A _ {y} \right] \\ = - \frac {q}{m ^ {2}} \left[ \left(- \mathrm {i} \hbar \frac {\partial A _ {x}}{\partial y}\right) \psi + \left(\mathrm {i} \hbar \frac {\partial A _ {y}}{\partial x}\right) \psi \right] \\ = - \frac {q}{m ^ {2}} \left(\mathrm {i} \hbar \frac {\partial A _ {y}}{\partial x} - \mathrm {i} \hbar \frac {\partial A _ {x}}{\partial y}\right) \psi . \\ \end{array}
$$

所以，

$$
[ v _ {y}, v _ {x} ] = - \frac {q}{m ^ {2}} \left(\mathrm {i} \hbar \frac {\partial A _ {y}}{\partial x} - \mathrm {i} \hbar \frac {\partial A _ {x}}{\partial y}\right) = - \frac {\mathrm {i} \hbar q}{m ^ {2}} (\nabla \times \boldsymbol {A}) _ {z} = - \frac {\mathrm {i} \hbar q}{m ^ {2}} B _ {z}.
$$

同样，

$$
[ v _ {z}, v _ {x} ] = - \frac {q}{m ^ {2}} \left(\mathrm {i} \hbar \frac {\partial A _ {z}}{\partial x} - \mathrm {i} \hbar \frac {\partial A _ {x}}{\partial z}\right) = \frac {\mathrm {i} \hbar q}{m ^ {2}} (\nabla \times \boldsymbol {A}) _ {y} = \frac {\mathrm {i} \hbar q}{m ^ {2}} B _ {y}.
$$

因此，

$$
\left[ v ^ {2}, v _ {x} \right] = \frac {\mathrm {i} \hbar q}{m ^ {2}} \left(- v _ {y} B _ {z} - B _ {z} v _ {y} + v _ {z} B _ {y} + B _ {y} v _ {z}\right) = \frac {\mathrm {i} \hbar q}{m ^ {2}} \left[ - \left(\boldsymbol {v} \times \boldsymbol {B}\right) _ {x} + \left(\boldsymbol {B} \times \boldsymbol {v}\right) _ {x} \right].
$$

推广到兰维'

$$
\left[ v ^ {2}, \boldsymbol {v} \right] = \frac {\mathrm {i} \hbar q}{m ^ {2}} \left[ - (\boldsymbol {v} \times \boldsymbol {B}) + (\boldsymbol {B} \times \boldsymbol {v}) \right].
$$

再来看

$$
\begin{array}{l} \frac {\mathrm {d} \langle \boldsymbol {v} \rangle}{\mathrm {d} t} = \frac {\mathrm {i}}{\hbar} \left\langle [ H, \boldsymbol {v} ] \right\rangle + \left\langle \frac {\partial \boldsymbol {v}}{\partial t} \right\rangle \\ = \frac {\mathrm {i}}{\hbar} \left\langle \left\{\frac {m}{2} \frac {\mathrm {i} \hbar q}{m ^ {2}} [ - (\boldsymbol {v} \times \boldsymbol {B}) + (\boldsymbol {B} \times \boldsymbol {v}) ] \right\} + \frac {\mathrm {i} \hbar q}{m} \nabla \varphi \right\rangle - \frac {q}{m} \left\langle \frac {\partial \boldsymbol {A}}{\partial t} \right\rangle . \\ \end{array}
$$

所以

$$
m \frac {\mathrm {d} \langle \boldsymbol {v} \rangle}{\mathrm {d} t} = \frac {q}{2} \left\langle \left[ (\boldsymbol {v} \times \boldsymbol {B}) - (\boldsymbol {B} \times \boldsymbol {v}) \right] \right\rangle + q \left\langle - \nabla \varphi - \frac {\partial \boldsymbol {A}}{\partial t} \right\rangle = \frac {q}{2} \left\langle \left[ (\boldsymbol {v} \times \boldsymbol {B}) - (\boldsymbol {B} \times \boldsymbol {v}) \right] \right\rangle + q \left\langle \boldsymbol {E} \right\rangle .
$$

将 $\textbf {  { v } }$ 用 $\pmb { p }$ 表示，得

$$
\begin{array}{l} (\boldsymbol {v} \times \boldsymbol {B}) - (\boldsymbol {B} \times \boldsymbol {v}) = \frac {1}{m} [ (\boldsymbol {p} - q \boldsymbol {A}) \times \boldsymbol {B} - \boldsymbol {B} \times (\boldsymbol {p} - q \boldsymbol {A}) ] \\ = \frac {1}{m} (\boldsymbol {p} \times \boldsymbol {B} - \boldsymbol {B} \times \boldsymbol {p}) - \frac {q}{m} (\boldsymbol {A} \times \boldsymbol {B} - \boldsymbol {B} \times \boldsymbol {A}). \\ \end{array}
$$

因此， $m \frac { \mathrm { d } \left. \pmb { v } \right. } { \mathrm { d } t } = q \left. \pmb { E } \right. + \frac { q } { 2 m } \left. \left( \pmb { p } \times \pmb { B } - \pmb { B } \times \pmb { p } \right) \right. - \frac { q ^ { 2 } } { m } \left. \left( \pmb { A } \times \pmb { B } \right) \right. .$ q

(c) 如果 $\pmb { { \cal E } }$ 和 $\mathbfit { \Delta } B$ 是均匀的，则 $\scriptstyle \langle E \rangle = E , \langle v \times B \rangle = - \langle B \times v \rangle = - B \times \langle v \rangle$ .结舍 (b) 中结论，得

$$
m \frac {d \langle \boldsymbol {v} \rangle}{\mathrm {d} t} = q (\boldsymbol {E} + \langle \boldsymbol {v} \rangle \times \boldsymbol {B}).
$$

事*串习题 4.43 假设:

$$
\pmb {A} = \frac {B _ {0}}{2} (x \hat {j} - y \hat {i}), \quad \varphi = K z ^ {2},
$$

其中 $B _ { 0 }$ 和 $K$ 为常数.

(a) 求电场 $\pmb { { \cal E } }$ 和磁感应强度 $\textbf {  { B } }$   
(b) 对处在上述电磁场中质量为 $m$ 、电荷为 $q$ 的粒子，计算出能量允许值.

答案:

$$
E \left(n _ {1}, n _ {2}\right) = \left(n _ {1} + \frac {1}{2}\right) \hbar \omega_ {1} + \left(n _ {2} + \frac {1}{2}\right) \hbar \omega_ {2} \quad \left(n _ {1}, n _ {2} = 0, 1, 2, \dots\right),
$$

其中 $\omega _ { 1 } \equiv q B _ { 0 } / m , \omega _ { 2 } \equiv \sqrt { 2 q K / m }$ .注释在二维情况下 $x$ 和 $y , K = 0 ,$ )，这是回旋运动的量子类比 $\omega _ { 1 }$ 川经典的回旋频率 $\omega _ { 2 }$ 川 能量允许值是 $\left( n _ { 1 } + \frac { 1 } { 2 } \right) \hbar \omega _ { 1 } .$ 称为朗遭能级.①

解答 (a)

$$
\boldsymbol {E} = - \nabla \varphi - \partial \boldsymbol {A} / \partial t = - K \nabla z ^ {2} = - 2 K z \hat {k}.
$$

$$
\boldsymbol {B} = \nabla \times \boldsymbol {A} = \left| \begin{array}{c c c} \hat {i} & \hat {j} & \hat {k} \\ \partial / \partial x & \partial / \partial y & \partial / \partial z \\ - B _ {0} y / 2 & B _ {0} x / 2 & 0 \end{array} \right| = B _ {0} \hat {k}.
$$

(b)

$$
H = \frac {1}{2 m} (\boldsymbol {p} - q \boldsymbol {A}) ^ {2} + q \varphi = \frac {p ^ {2}}{2 m} - \frac {q}{2 m} (\boldsymbol {p} \boldsymbol {A} + \boldsymbol {A p}) + \frac {q ^ {2} A ^ {2}}{2 m} + q \varphi ,
$$

定态薛定诗方程为

$$
\frac {- \hbar^ {2} \nabla^ {2} \psi}{2 m} + \frac {\mathrm {i} \hbar q}{2 m} \left[ \nabla \cdot (\pmb {A} \psi) + \pmb {A} \cdot \nabla \psi \right] + \frac {q ^ {2} A ^ {2}}{2 m} \psi + q \varphi \psi = E \psi ,
$$

但是

$$
\nabla (\boldsymbol {A} \psi) = (\nabla \cdot \boldsymbol {A}) \psi + \boldsymbol {A} \cdot (\nabla \psi),
$$

所以

$$
\frac {- \hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \nabla^ {2} \psi + \frac {\mathrm {i} \hbar q}{2 m} \left[ (\nabla \cdot \boldsymbol {A}) \psi + 2 \boldsymbol {A} \cdot \nabla \psi \right] + \left(\frac {q ^ {2} A ^ {2}}{2 m} + q \varphi\right) \psi = E \psi .
$$

对本题所给矢势

$$
\nabla \cdot \boldsymbol {A} = 0,
$$

$$
\boldsymbol {A} \cdot \nabla \psi = \frac {B _ {0}}{2} \left(x \frac {\partial \psi}{\partial y} - y \frac {\partial \psi}{\partial x}\right) = \frac {B _ {0}}{2} \frac {\mathrm {i}}{\hbar} \hat {L} _ {z} \psi ,
$$

$$
A ^ {2} = \frac {B _ {0} ^ {2}}{4} \left(x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}\right),
$$

$$
\varphi = K z ^ {2}.
$$

又 $L _ { z }$ 与 $H$ 对易，且有 $L _ { z } \psi = m _ { z } \hbar \psi$ ，所以定态方程为

$$
\left[ \frac {- \hbar^ {2} \nabla^ {2} \psi}{2 m} + \frac {q ^ {2} B _ {0} ^ {2}}{8 m} (x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}) + q K z ^ {2} \right] \psi = \left(E + \frac {q B _ {0}}{2 m} m _ {z} \hbar\right) \psi .
$$

令 $\omega _ { 1 } = q B _ { 0 } / m$ $\omega _ { 2 } = \sqrt { 2 K q / m }$ ，采用柱坐标系有

$$
\frac {- \hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \left[ \frac {1}{r ^ {2}} \frac {\partial}{\partial r} \left(r \frac {\partial \psi}{\partial r}\right) + \frac {1}{r ^ {2}} \frac {\partial^ {2} \psi}{\partial \varphi^ {2}} + \frac {\partial^ {2} \psi}{\partial z ^ {2}} \right] + \left(\frac {1}{8} m \omega_ {1} ^ {2} r ^ {2} + \frac {1}{2} m \omega_ {2} ^ {2} z ^ {2}\right) \psi
$$

$$
= \left(E + \frac {1}{2} m _ {z} \hbar \omega_ {1}\right) \psi .
$$

用分离变量法，记 $\psi = R \left( r \right) \varPhi \left( \varphi \right) Z \left( z \right)$ ，则

$$
\begin{array}{l} \left\{\frac {- \hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \left[ \frac {1}{R r} \frac {\mathrm {d}}{\mathrm {d} r} \left(r \frac {\mathrm {d} R}{\mathrm {d} r}\right) - \frac {m _ {z} ^ {2}}{r ^ {2}} \right] + \frac {1}{8} m \omega_ {1} ^ {2} r ^ {2} \right\} + \left(- \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \frac {1}{Z} \frac {\mathrm {d} ^ {2} Z}{\mathrm {d} z ^ {2}} + \frac {1}{2} m \omega_ {2} ^ {2} z ^ {2}\right) \\ = E + \frac {m _ {z} \hbar \omega_ {1}}{2}. \\ \end{array}
$$

第一项只与 $r$ 有关，第二项只与 $z$ 有关，因此可设

$$
\begin{array}{l} - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \left[ \frac {1}{R r} \frac {\mathrm {d}}{\mathrm {d} r} \left(r \frac {\mathrm {d} R}{\mathrm {d} r}\right) - \frac {m _ {z} ^ {2}}{r ^ {2}} \right] + \frac {1}{8} m \omega_ {1} ^ {2} r ^ {2} = E _ {r}, \\ - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \frac {1}{Z} \frac {\mathrm {d} ^ {2} Z}{\mathrm {d} z ^ {2}} + \frac {1}{2} m \omega_ {2} ^ {2} z ^ {2} = E _ {z}, \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
E \equiv E _ {r} + E _ {z} - \frac {m _ {z} \hbar \omega_ {1}}{2}.
$$

显然，第二部分为一维谐振子方程，

$$
E _ {z} = \left(n _ {z} + \frac {1}{2}\right) \hbar \omega_ {2},
$$
